name: Huru
story: The National Library’s explanatory account names Huru as the Māori man taken with Tuki from near the Cavalli Islands to Norfolk Island in 1793. Its catalogue entry for Tuki’s map uses the spelling Huku. This record keeps both spellings as source variants and adds no further biographical detail.
